Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing small appurtenances on recreational vehicles.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to recreational vehicle appurtenances; and addinga new section to chapter 46.44 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.44 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Motor homes, travel trailers, and campers may exceed the maximumwidth established under RCW 46.44.010 if the excess width isattributable to appurtenances that extend no further than six inchesbeyond either sidewall of the vehicle. For purposes of this section,an appurtenance is an integral part of the vehicle and includes, but isnot limited to, awnings, grab handles, lighting equipment, vents, andcameras. An appurtenance on the sidewall of a vehicle may not be usedas a load carrying device.
